# Contributing — generated by init-workspace.ps1

Thank you for considering contributing to this project.
## Getting Started

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a feature branch: git checkout -b feature/my-feature
3. Commit your changes
4. Push and open a Pull Request

## Development Workflow

### Prerequisites
- Git
- For project-specific tools, see the generated CI workflow at .github/workflows/ci.yml

### Code Style
This project uses:
- EditorConfig (.editorconfig) for basic formatting
- Stack-specific linters (ESLint, Ruff, golangci-lint, etc.) — run lint before committing

### Pre-commit Hooks
Install pre-commit hooks to catch issues before CI:
`ash
pip install pre-commit
pre-commit install
pre-commit run --all-files
`

### Commit Messages
Use clear, descriptive commit messages. Prefix with the area:
- eat: — new feature
- ix: — bug fix
- docs: — documentation
- efactor: — code restructuring
- 	est: — test changes

### Before Submitting
- [ ] Run pwsh ./run-checks.ps1
- [ ] Run lint checks
- [ ] Ensure all tests pass
- [ ] Add tests for new functionality

## Questions?
Open a GitHub Discussion or refer to the project documentation.
